features.title: Station Folder generator
features.behavior: Create a validated Station Folder from one Source Video Target Window using the v1 folder contract.

features.title: Perceptual-hash Frame Collapse
features.behavior: Sample at 2 fps, reduce near-duplicate frames by perceptual-hash distance, and write frame-collapse-report.json.

features.title: Temporal Strip renderer
features.behavior: Render a non-HTML temporal-strip.png from marked frames with embedded timing labels.

features.title: Agent output validator
features.behavior: Validate agent-output/output.json and replacement-render.mp4 before merge.

features.title: ffmpeg Normalizing Merge
features.behavior: Merge one completed Station into the Source Video while preserving original audio and writing merge evidence.
